overview: A pen at the spawn, for two kinds of people: the ones who have not said the password yet, and the ones an operator has put there.

1.0.4: Somebody still at the door is held from everything, not just from the world: the greeting and the list of what the server runs wait until the password is answered.
1.0.3: No change to play: a fresh number so the build had a file of its own to go up.
1.0.2: Your game is handed a pass when you are let in, so a household whose address changes every few days is not asked for the password all over again. Forgetting a name, or setting a new password, takes the passes with it. Anyone who logged out in another dimension is greeted properly now.
1.0.0: The pen: held within sixteen blocks of world spawn behind a border wall only you can see, unable to touch anything and unable to be hurt, and put back exactly where you were taken from. A newcomer is asked for the password in chat, which a stock client can answer, and an operator can jail somebody for a while or until freed.
